subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: How we keep our bodies clean; names cleaning products, what they are used for and on which body part

show.line: We keep our bodies clean. Soap for skin, shampoo for hair, toothpaste for teeth!

rounds.prompt: What do we use to wash our hair?
What do we use to dry our body?
What do you use to wash your body?
Tap the child who is clean.

hints: Each thing has its own job.
Think: does it go on hair, teeth or skin?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will brush my teeth.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I put shampoo on my toothbrush!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Toothpaste goes on a toothbrush.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Toothpaste for teeth. Shampoo for hair!

parent_line: Knows which cleaning products are used on which part of the body.
